info.title: Secondlayer Public API
info.description: This instance: Index (decoded chain events), Streams (raw firehose), Subgraphs (the schemas you deployed), and the `/api` write plane that deploys and drives them. Cursor format is `<block_height>:<event_index>` on Index/Streams; opaque on Subgraphs. Auth on this instance is the token minted by `secondlayer init` (`INSTANCE_TOKEN`), sent as `Authorization: Bearer $INSTANCE_TOKEN`. `/v1` reads need no credential while the API is reachable only over loopback and require the token on every request once it is published past loopback: one rule, identical on Index, Streams, and Subgraphs, which is why every read below lists bearer auth as optional. Writes under `/api` require the token whenever one is set, and must send `Content-Type: application/json` (anything else is refused with 415 `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`). Hosted `api.secondlayer.tools` uses an account key; see https://www.secondlayer.tools/docs/authentication.

bearerAuth.description: The instance token from `secondlayer init`: 32 random bytes, hex-encoded, read from `INSTANCE_TOKEN`. Optional on `/v1` reads served over a loopback bind, required on every request once the instance is reachable past loopback, and required on every `/api` write whenever a token is set. ArchiveVerifyResult.title: archive verification
ArchiveVerifyResult.description: The outcome of an archive comparison.

status.description: `clean`: every range matched. `diverged`: at least one did not. `unanchored`: the comparison could not be trusted or run; see `reason`.

signature.description: Whether the manifest signature verified, and why not when it did not.

coverage.description: Lowest and highest height compared. Absent when nothing was compared.

ranges.description: One row per compared range. `status` is `match`, `digest-mismatch`, `count-mismatch`, or `missing` when this instance has no rows there. Digests are `null` for an empty range.

reason.description: Why the result is `unanchored`: `no public key`, the fetch error, the signature failure, or `no digests`.

SubgraphRow.title: subgraph row
SubgraphRow.description: One row of a subgraph table. Every table has the four system columns below; the definition's own columns follow, each as its JSON type: `uint` and `int` (Postgres NUMERIC) as decimal strings, so values past 2^53 stay exact; `text` and `principal` as strings; `boolean` as a boolean; `timestamp` as an ISO 8601 string; `jsonb` as JSON. A `nullable` column can be `null`. `_fields` narrows the set.

_id.description: Row id, increasing in insert order. A string: Postgres BIGINT. The default page order and cursor.

_block_height.description: Stacks block the row was written at. A string: Postgres BIGINT.

_tx_id.description: Transaction whose event produced the row.

_created_at.description: When the indexer wrote the row, not the block time.

SubgraphTip.description: How far this subgraph has indexed, against the chain tip.

block_height.description: Highest Stacks block this instance has indexed.

rows.description: The page, in `_id` order or `_sort` order.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page. Set on every full page, so the page after the last full one can be empty. `null` on a short page, which means you are at the end. Without `_sort` it is the last row's `_id`; with `_sort` it is an opaque token.

count.description: Rows matching the filters, or the planner's estimate for an unfiltered `_count=estimate`.

SubgraphAggregates.title: subgraph aggregates
SubgraphAggregates.description: Only the aggregates you asked for are present. Sums, minimums and maximums are strings so large values stay exact.

sum.description: Sum per `_sum` column. `"0"` over no rows.

min.description: Minimum per `_min` column. `null` over no rows.

max.description: Maximum per `_max` column. `null` over no rows.

IndexEvent.title: Index event
IndexEvent.description: One decoded event, flat. The universal columns are always there; the rest depend on `event_type`, and a type's own columns are always set for its rows.

block_height.description: Stacks block the row landed in.

tx_index.description: The transaction's position in its block.

event_index.description: The event's position in the block. With `block_height`, the cursor.

event_type.description: The event type. Decides which columns are set.

contract_id.description: Contract that emitted the event. `null` for STX transfers, mints, burns and locks.

sender.description: Sending principal. The locked address on `stx_lock`.

amount.description: Amount as a decimal string (bigint-safe). microSTX on STX types.

value.description: NFT id as hex-encoded Clarity, on nft types.

payload.description: Decoded print payload on `print`; `{ unlock_height }` on `stx_lock`.

tx_contract_id.description: Contract the submitting transaction called or deployed. Only with `tx_context=true`.

tx_function_name.description: Function the submitting transaction called. Only with `tx_context=true`.

block_height.description: Stacks block the row landed in.

tx_index.description: The transaction's position in its block.

event_index.description: The event's position in the block. With `block_height`, the cursor.

amount.description: Amount in the token's base units, as a decimal string (bigint-safe).

block_height.description: Stacks block the row landed in.

tx_index.description: The transaction's position in its block.

event_index.description: The event's position in the block. With `block_height`, the cursor.

value.description: The token id as hex-encoded Clarity.

ContractCall.title: contract call
ContractCall.description: One top-level contract-call transaction, arguments and result decoded to JSON. Clarity integers come back as decimal strings.

block_height.description: Stacks block the row landed in.

tx_index.description: The transaction's position in its block.

result.description: Decoded result. `null` when there is none.

CanonicalBlock.title: canonical block
CanonicalBlock.description: One height of the canonical chain: the hash, its parent, and the Bitcoin anchor. Every row is canonical.

block_height.description: Stacks block height.

parent_hash.description: The parent block's hash, to check linkage.

burn_block_height.description: The Bitcoin block it anchors to.

Block.title: block
Block.description: A Stacks block: chain linkage and Bitcoin anchor. Only what ingest stores; no miner, tx count or cost data.

block_height.description: Stacks block height.

burn_block_height.description: The Bitcoin block it anchors to.

index_block_hash.description: Nakamoto block id. Pass it as `?tip=` to a node read-only call to pin the read to this block. `null` on rows ingested before it was stored.

canonical.description: Whether the block is on the canonical chain. Always `true` in the list; a hash lookup can return an orphan.

PostCondition.description: A decoded post-condition. `type` decides the shape: `stx`, `ft` and `staking` carry `amount`; `ft` and `nft` carry `asset_identifier`; `nft` carries `asset_value`; `pox` carries neither.

principal.description: Principal the condition applies to, or `origin`.

condition_code_name.description: Its name, e.g. `sent_eq`, `not_sent`, `will_perform`. `null` for an unknown code.

amount.description: Amount as a decimal string, on `stx`, `ft`, `staking`.

Transaction.title: transaction
Transaction.description: A confirmed transaction: stored columns plus what decodes from the raw bytes. Payload objects appear only for the matching `tx_type`. Decoded fields are `null` when the raw bytes do not decode (burnchain ops).

block_height.description: Stacks block the row landed in.

burn_block_height.description: The Bitcoin block its Stacks block anchors to.

tx_index.description: The transaction's position in its block.

tx_type.description: `token_transfer`, `contract_call`, `smart_contract`, `coinbase`, `tenure_change` or `poison_microblock`, decoded from the raw bytes. Falls back to the stored type when they do not decode.

fee.description: Fee in microSTX as a decimal string. `null` when the raw bytes do not decode.

nonce.description: Sender nonce as a decimal string.

sponsored.description: Whether a sponsor paid the fee.

anchor_mode.description: Anchor mode from the raw bytes.

post_condition_mode.description: Post-condition mode from the raw bytes.

post_conditions.description: Decoded post-conditions. Empty when there are none.

function_args_hex.description: The same arguments as hex-encoded Clarity.

result.description: Decoded result. `null` when there is none.

MempoolTransaction.title: mempool transaction
MempoolTransaction.description: A pending transaction: the transaction document before it has a block, so no height, index, status or result, plus when this instance first saw it.

cursor.description: Opaque. Pass it back as `cursor` unchanged.

received_at.description: When this instance's node first saw it, ISO 8601 UTC.

tx_type.description: `token_transfer`, `contract_call`, `smart_contract`, `coinbase`, `tenure_change` or `poison_microblock`, decoded from the raw bytes. Falls back to the stored type when they do not decode.

fee.description: Fee in microSTX as a decimal string. `null` when the raw bytes do not decode.

nonce.description: Sender nonce as a decimal string.

sponsored.description: Whether a sponsor paid the fee.

anchor_mode.description: Anchor mode from the raw bytes.

post_condition_mode.description: Post-condition mode from the raw bytes.

post_conditions.description: Decoded post-conditions. Empty when there are none.

TransactionProof.title: transaction proof
TransactionProof.description: Everything needed to verify inclusion offline. Hex values have no `0x` prefix.

index_block_hash.description: Nakamoto block id. Recompute it from `raw_header`.

block_height.description: Stacks block height.

tx_index.description: The transaction's position in the block; the merkle leaf index.

raw_header.description: The serialized Nakamoto block header, signer signatures included.

tx_merkle_path.description: Sibling hashes from the leaf up to the header's tx merkle root.

position.description: Which side the sibling sits on.

consensus.description: The reward cycle and its signer set, to check the header's signatures pass 70% of signer weight. Absent when the node cannot resolve the set.

reward_set.description: Signers and their weights for that cycle.

PrintSchema.title: print schema
PrintSchema.description: A contract's print payloads, grouped by `topic` and typed field by field from the events sampled.

topics.description: One entry per `topic` value. Prints with no string `topic` group under `*`.

first_height.description: Lowest block height seen for it.

last_height.description: Highest block height seen for it.

non_tuple.description: Whether some payloads were not tuples.

camel_name.description: The key a subgraph handler sees on `event.data`.

clarity_type.description: Clarity type. buff and string lengths are the largest seen.

column_type.description: Subgraph column type that fits it.

always_present.description: Present in every sampled event of this topic.

optional_some_rate.description: For optionals: share of samples that were `some`.

sampled.description: `true` when the contract has more print events than were read.

total_events.description: Canonical print events for the contract, capped at 50000.

IndexDiscovery.title: Index discovery
IndexDiscovery.description: Every Index route with the filters it accepts.

routes.description: One entry per route: `path`, `method`, `description`, and `filters` where it takes any. The `/v1/index/events` entry adds `event_types` and `event_type_filters` (columns and accepted filters per type).

cursor.description: Cursor format and how to resume with it.

routes.description: Alias for /events?event_type=ft_transfer. Fungible token transfers, decoded + filterable.
Canonical blocks, cursor-paginated. Returns blocks[] ({block_height, block_hash, parent_hash, burn_block_height, burn_block_hash, block_time, canonical}), next_cursor, tip.

StackingAction.title: PoX-4 stacking action
StackingAction.description: One decoded PoX-4 contract call. Which columns are set depends on `function_name`; a failed call sets only the base fields.

block_height.description: Stacks block the call landed in.

burn_block_height.description: Bitcoin block that Stacks block anchors to.

tx_index.description: Its position in the block. With `block_height`, the cursor.

stacker.description: Stacker the call acts on, on delegate-side calls. Null on solo `stack-stx`, where `caller` is the stacker.

amount_ustx.description: microSTX as a decimal string (bigint-safe): the amount locked, delegated or increased by.

pox_addr.description: Bitcoin reward address. Every field is null when the call names none.

start_cycle.description: First reward cycle the lock covers.

end_cycle.description: Last reward cycle the lock covers.

reward_cycle.description: Reward cycle named by aggregation and signer-key calls. What `/v1/index/pox/cycles` groups on.

PoxCycle.title: PoX-4 reward cycle
PoxCycle.description: Rollup of the canonical PoX-4 calls that name one reward cycle: the aggregation commits and increases.

total_stacked_ustx.description: Sum of `amount_ustx` over the cycle's calls, as a decimal string. Commits carry no amount, so this is the sum of aggregation increases.

unique_stackers.description: Distinct non-null `stacker` values among the cycle's calls.

unique_delegators.description: Distinct callers of `delegate-*` functions among the cycle's calls.

start_block_height.description: Stacks block of the first such call.

end_block_height.description: Stacks block of the last such call.

is_current.description: True for the highest cycle while PoX-4 is still live. Always false after the epoch 4.0 fork.

Pox5Event.title: PoX-5 event
Pox5Event.description: One print event from the pox-5 boot contract, decoded. Promoted columns cover the common filters; `data` always holds the complete tuple, so no topic loses fields.

block_height.description: Stacks block the print landed in.

event_index.description: The event's position in the block. With `block_height`, the cursor.

topic.description: The print topic. Decides which columns are set.

signer_manager.description: Signer-manager contract, on claim and grant topics.

bond_index.description: The bond this event belongs to, on bond topics.

reward_cycle.description: Reward cycle the event refers to, on reward and claim topics.

first_reward_cycle.description: First cycle a stake earns in.

unlock_burn_height.description: Bitcoin block height the stake unlocks at.

is_l1_lock.description: Bond registrations: whether the lockup is on Bitcoin L1.

signer_key.description: Signer public key, on key-grant topics.

data.description: The full decoded print tuple. Nested shapes (btc-lockup, bond-rewards, bond-periods) come through intact.

SbtcEvent.description: One decoded `sbtc-registry` print. Every topic shares this shape; `topic` decides which columns are set.

event_index.description: The event's position in the block. With `block_height`, the cursor.

amount.description: Sats as a decimal string, on deposits and withdrawal requests.

sender.description: Stacks principal, e.g. the withdrawal requester.

recipient_btc_version.description: Bitcoin address type of the recipient: 0 p2pkh, 1 p2sh, 2 p2sh-p2wpkh, 3 p2sh-p2wsh, 4 p2wpkh, 5 p2wsh, 6 p2tr.

bitcoin_txid.description: Bitcoin txid, `0x`-prefixed hex: the deposit transaction, or the sweep on an accept.

burn_hash.description: Bitcoin block hash the signers anchored the event to.

signer_bitmap.description: Bitmap of the signers' votes, as a decimal string.

max_fee.description: Most the requester will pay in BTC fees, in sats.

fee.description: BTC fee charged on an accepted withdrawal, in sats.

signer_keys_count.description: Number of signer keys in the new set, on `key-rotation`.

recipient_btc_version.description: Bitcoin address type of the recipient: 0 p2pkh, 1 p2sh, 2 p2sh-p2wpkh, 3 p2sh-p2wsh, 4 p2wpkh, 5 p2wsh, 6 p2tr.
